title: DSA Capstone Projects Catalog
subtitle: Industrial C data structures projects with full source code & memory management implementations

projects.title: Custom Heap-Backed Dynamic Memory Pool Allocator
projects.description: Implement a custom memory allocator managing a fixed 1KB byte pool using block header metadata, free list tracking, and explicit allocation/deallocation routines (`myMalloc` and `myFree`).

projects.title: Doubly-Linked Text Editor State Undo/Redo Buffer
projects.description: Design an undo/redo buffer engine for a text editor using a Doubly Linked List of state nodes, handling boundary state truncation during edit branches.

projects.title: Graph-Based City Transit Navigation System (Dijkstra)
projects.description: Build a shortest path routing engine using an adjacency matrix representation and Dijkstra's algorithm to compute minimum transit distances between map nodes.
